Swipe right on the text to read it beside the Russian, or tap the EN button on the right. «От автора» has no English — her chapter files begin with the novel itself — so the translation starts at chapter 2. Her prose is graceful where Dostoevsky is deliberately raw and hurried, and she now and then softens or steps past what she found difficult, so the two languages will not always meet word for word. Where they part, the Russian is Dostoevsky.
